status: FROZEN BEFORE P0 RUNS. No policy has been evaluated under the thermal channel.
what_is_predicted: the ORDER in which the five frozen policies lose success as thermal severity rises, relative to each policy's own severity-zero score

the_measured_basis.statistic: torque_saturation = fraction of (timestep, joint) samples at or beyond 95% of the peak limit. It is the only clean torque-relative-to-limit statistic these runs recorded; energy_proxy mixes torque with joint speed and cannot be inverted to a duty cycle.

prediction_1_ordering.claim: relative loss under thermal stress orders by torque saturation, most vulnerable first
prediction_1_ordering.falsified_if: the observed order of relative loss has Spearman correlation below +0.5 with this one

prediction_2_the_interesting_one.claim: fixed randomization, which wins or ties on every channel measured so far, is the SECOND most thermally vulnerable arm, and the low-effort adaptive arms are the least. If the ordering holds, thermal stress partially reverses the ranking that every other channel produces.
prediction_2_the_interesting_one.why_it_matters: a channel that reorders the arms is measuring something the existing six do not, which is the entire reason to add one
prediction_2_the_interesting_one.falsified_if: fixed@s8600 loses no more, relative to its own baseline, than lucid_rg@s8600 and lucid_ratchet_rg@s8600

prediction_3_where_it_bites.claim: the first ladder severity at which fixed@s8600 drops below 0.90 success is lam = 1 or lam = 2, not lam = 0.5 and not beyond 3
prediction_3_where_it_bites.reasoning: 3.2% of its joint-samples run at 95% of peak or above. At duty 1.0 a cold joint reaches onset in 3.0 s at lam 0.5, 1.4 s at lam 1 and 0.7 s at lam 2, against a 4 s clip, so the saturating joints derate within the clip from lam 0.5 upward; whether that costs success depends on whether the saturating joints are load-bearing. lam 0.5 is included precisely as the severity expected NOT to matter.
prediction_3_where_it_bites.falsified_if: no severity in the ladder drops it below 0.90, or lam = 0.5 already does

prediction_4_the_mechanism.claim: the arms' relative loss correlates better with torque saturation than with their success at phys_200
prediction_4_the_mechanism.why: if thermal loss tracked general robustness instead of effort, the channel would be redundant with the scalar ladder rather than new
prediction_4_the_mechanism.falsified_if: the correlation with phys_200 success is at least as strong

not_predicted: absolute success at any severity; the thermal constants are assumptions and the timescale is compressed
anything about a curriculum. These are frozen-policy evaluations with no training at all
scoring: score every prediction the moment P0's receipts exist, before any further design decision, and record misses as prominently as hits
